T0542.title: Temporary Credential
T0542.definition: A short-lived credential issued for bounded access, reducing exposure compared with long-lived secrets.
T0542.description: Temporary credentials reduce exposure by using short lifetimes and bounded privileges. They are useful for CI/CD, cloud access, third-party operations, and cross-account authorization. Designs should review issuance conditions, permission scope, session duration, revocation, and log correlation so short-lived credentials do not become durable backdoors.
T0542.usageExample: Assess Temporary Credential related exposure and define the corresponding controls.
